detail: Full summary: a bare `:(exclude)*.tmp` pathspec makes `git add <dir>` skip every UNTRACKED file under <dir> on git 2.50.1 while still staging modified tracked files, exit 0, no message (EXECUTED 2026-09-05, scratchpad/verify-pathspec-and-argv.sh). Any recipe or script using an unanchored exclude with git add silently drops new files. Anchor excludes to a directory prefix.
